title: GATFuse: gene fusion detection from RNA-seq using graph attention networks
description: GATFuse reformulates gene fusion detection as an edge-classification problem on graphs. Each RNA-seq sample is represented as a graph whose nodes are expressed genes and whose edges are the chimeric junctions reported by STAR; a Graph Attention Network (GATv2) conditioned on junction-level features scores each candidate and reports a calibrated probability. The release includes graph construction from STAR output, training, inference, post-processing, and a model pretrained on 101 RNA-seq samples with literature-confirmed fusions.
